However, the comment lacks depth and does not provide constructive suggestions on how to improve the fairness of comparisons beyond simply answering the questions. It does not explain why the current comparisons are unfair or offer guidance on what constitutes a fair comparison. Thus, while it is somewhat helpful, it is incomplete and lacks the comprehensive, detailed suggestions that would make it highly impactful. This aligns with a score of 3."
